Quick Q&A (for procurement):
- Data retention: Default retention is 90 days for request-level logs; customers can configure longer retention for embeddings and stored artifacts up to contractual limits. We provide a managed retention policy and can support custom retention on Dedicated/Private deployments.
- Hard delete: We support hard deletion for customer-controlled data; deletion requests are processed within 48 hours for hosted accounts and according to on-prem procedures for Private deployments.
- Audit logs: We expose audit logs via our Console and can export as JSON/CSV. Standard retention is 90 days for hosted; Dedicated customers can extend retention.
- Encryption: Data is encrypted in transit (TLS 1.2+) and at rest with customer-managed KMS options for Dedicated/Private.

Hi Samir  Neha from Redwood security. Adding the technical clarifications Ravi/procurement typically asks for. See answers below; happy to jump on a call if Aditya wants to go deeper.

1) SOC 2 Type II
- Most recent period: Jan 1, 2025  Dec 31, 2025. Report attached (redacted).

2) Penetration test
- Summary attached. Latest test completed: 2025-11-14. Vendor: SecureAudit Labs. No critical findings; remediation records available on request.

3) Audit logs
- What we capture: API calls (request metadata), admin actions (user create/delete/role changes), authentication events.
- Export formats: JSON, CSV.
- Retention: Default hosted retention 90 days. For Dedicated customers retention can be configured to 1 year or longer via enterprise config.
- Access: Logs accessible via Console with RBAC or via S3 export for Dedicated.

4) Data deletion and retention controls
- Hard delete: Support immediate deletion for request-scoped data. For immutable model artifacts we provide configurable retention knobs and documented deletion flows.
- Backup copies: Backups are rotated per policy; deletion requests remove live copies and initiate retention-window policies for backups (we can provide contractual language).

5) Encryption and key management
- In transit: TLS 1.2+ with modern ciphers.
- At rest: AES-256. Customer-managed KMS supported for Dedicated/Private.

6) Data residency
- Hosted: regional processing in US and EU regions (you can choose). Dedicated/Private can be deployed in customer VPC on-prem.

7) Contacts for evidence and legal
- Security contact: neha.kapoor@redwood.com
- Legal: legal@redwood.com (for DPAs and contract redlines)

If Ravi or Aditya can send a short checklist (the procurement template), I can fill it out and return the filled artifact ahead of Tue's call.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Security Lead | Redwood Inference
